newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 16.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Frontpage article marks first in series of feature stories about Hong Kong to mark return to motherland. First story says Hong Kong has been part of China since ancient times.
- Premier Li Peng tours Sichuan province from June 11 to 14, visits gigantic Ertan Hydraulic Power Project, studies reform of state-owned enterprises and poverty relief work
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Ding Guangen, head of Propaganda Department, tells literary and art workers to work hard and produce works of higher quality and provide the people "with the best cultural sustenance"
CHINA SECURITIES
- Ministry of Finance sets detailed reules on clearing of treasury bills by China Government Securities Depository Trust and Clear Co
FINANCIAL NEWS
- China launches interbank treasury bill market
FUTURES HERALD
- Six foreign banks allowed to conduct yuan business in Shanghai make total of 269 million yuan in loans by end-May
MARKET DAILY
- Retail sales of consumer goods up 12.1 percent after inflation in January-May
- Bicycle production to reach 41 millin in 2000, exports at 10 million
CHINA BUSINESS TIMES
- Minsheng Bank signs agreements with five private firms to offer financial consultancy servies
- China aims to raise proportion of rent in worker's salaries to 15 percent
ECONOMIC DAILY
- Survey finds 50 percent of China's tea below standard
- Economist says that after taming inflation, unemployment is becoming striking problem
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- China delivers $5.0 million worth of sugar crushing equipment to Vietnam
CHINA DAILY
- President Jiang Zemin writes inscription to mark completion of Hall of Hong Kong in Great Hall of the People
